content:
**Thunder Mountain Substation TM-01** is a location in The Mire region of Appalachia.

Connected to the Thunder Mountain Power Plant, this substation once routed power to Harpers Ferry and beyond. Now it is slowly being consumed by Strangler Vines.

The transformer enclosure has little in the way of loot, but will usually spawn numerous enemies. The confined spaces make it a decent choice for fighting oversized creatures, like Deathclaws or Anglers.

Thunder Mountain Substation TM-01 appears in *Fallout 76*.
